extraction.Name: Josephine Swallow nee Brown
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded Feb. 19, 1923, by Mrs. Ben Swallow (allottee)
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: deeded to Marcus Hallgren of Martin, So. Dak. by Josephine I. Swallow, formerly Josephine I. Brown, and Benjamin Swallow, Husb. and Wife, for $1.00 Etc. on Apr. 10, 1923
extraction.Buyer: Marcus Hallgren of Martin, So. Dak. for $1.00 Etc.
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jan. 15, 1920. Land description: NE-33-37-36. Conveyance recorded Apr. 16, 1923. Taken from the records at the County Seat. Allottee also identified as Josephine I. Brown (maiden name); husband Benjamin Swallow co-signed deed.
